hook: An AI is driving this *5 ton John Deere loader* on two wheels, and it spins
credit: ETH Zurich Robotic Systems Lab via @WevolverApp on X
caption:
Researchers at ETH Zurich trained an AI to drive a 5 ton John Deere 332G skid steer loader.
It rocks the machine up onto its front wheels, balances, spins and swings the bucket, then lands softly.
The controller learned by trial and error in simulation, and the work was published in Science Robotics.
